notes: Institutional Master's tuition-fee scholarship portfolio at Nova SBE (Nova School of Business and Economics, Universidade NOVA de Lisboa). Official page (https://www.novasbe.unl.pt/en/programs/scholarships-funding/masters) describes merit-based and social-mobility tuition-fee scholarships and partner awards (Nova SBE Merit Scholarship, Social Mobility, Continuity, Accenture, Antonio Serrenho, etc.). These are financial-aid awards for taught Master's programmes; no supervising professor or faculty member is tied to the scholarship, and the only contacts are the central scholarships/admissions office. Taught Master's degrees have no research supervisor. No professor could be evidenced without inventing a person, so professors is empty.

University of Porto internal financial-support portfolio. Official page (https://www.up.pt/portal/en/live/student-life/scholarships-and-funding) lists: (1) SASUP study scholarships = 'a monthly cash payment'; (2) Merit Scholarships = 'a cash prize for students... who display exceptional academic achievement'; (3) Scientific Scholarships = 'research scholarships' for undergraduate and postgraduate students 'aimed at scientific training in research projects or institutions'. No named supervising professor is attached to any of these schemes on the official page; published contacts are the administrative Servicos de Acao Social da U.Porto (SASUP, sas.up.pt) and the Reitoria, not academic supervisors. Research-scholarship holders join host projects whose supervisors are not identified on this portfolio page, so no professor could be evidenced.

Government scheme. Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua, I.P. is the Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs agency for external language and culture cooperation; the Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarship Programme is State-Budget funded with no attached host institution or supervising professor. Not applicable per rules (national/government scheme with no attached institution). Note: the specific path https://www.instituto-camoes.pt/en/scholarships returned HTTP 404 during research; the institutional root https://www.instituto-camoes.pt/ is the official domain.

Government/federal scheme. The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Master's (CGRS-M) is run by the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC) on the Government of Canada domain (canada.ca / sshr-csh.canada.ca). It is a national research-training award with no attached host institution; applicants apply directly to SSHRC or through a Canadian institution, which closes earlier. Published contact is the federal agency inbox fellowships@sshrc-crsh.gc.ca, not a supervising professor. Not applicable per rules (national/government scheme with no attached institution).

Government/federal scheme. The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Doctoral (CGRS-D) is run by SSHRC on the Government of Canada domain (canada.ca). It is a national research-training award with no attached host institution; two application routes are direct to SSHRC (deadline 19 Oct 2026) or through a Canadian institution. Published contact is the federal agency inbox fellowships@sshrc-crsh.gc.ca, not a supervising professor. Not applicable per rules (national/government scheme with no attached institution).

Government (provincial) scheme. The Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) is a merit-based provincial award jointly funded by the Province of Ontario (Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security) and administered for admission at U of T by the School of Graduate Studies. The Province allocates OGS awards to universities. It is not tied to any supervising professor; it is open to graduate students 'in all disciplines'. Published contacts are the Graduate Awards Office (ogs@utoronto.ca; Debbie Chau, Graduate Awards Officer), administrative officers rather than academic supervisors. Not applicable per rules (government-funded scheme with no attached institution/supervisor).
